title: How to Cancel Calm — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel Calm app subscription on iPhone, Android, or web. Stop the $14.99/mo charge. Keep free access to limited meditation content.
intro: Calm cancellation works the same way as most app subscriptions — through Apple, Google, or their website depending on where you signed up. Some free content remains available after canceling.

steps.title: Check where you subscribed
steps.text: Most Calm subscriptions are through Apple App Store or Google Play. Check Settings → Subscriptions on your device first.

steps.title: Cancel through the correct platform
steps.text: Apple: Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions → Calm → Cancel. Google: Play Store → Payments & subscriptions → Calm → Cancel. Web: calm.com/account/subscription → Cancel.
steps.tip: If you can't find Calm in your subscriptions, try the other platform or check calm.com/account.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Tap "Confirm" to finalize. Your Premium access continues until your billing period ends.

steps.title: Verify in the app
steps.text: Open the Calm app and check your account settings to confirm the subscription shows as canceled. Some free content (Daily Calm, limited sleep stories) remains accessible.

warnings: Lifetime subscriptions cannot be canceled (one-time purchase — you keep it forever).
Annual plans are not refundable after the first 30 days in most cases.
Canceling on calm.com does NOT cancel Apple/Google billing — cancel through the platform you subscribed on.
Downloaded content for offline use becomes unavailable after cancellation.

faqs.q: Does Calm have free content after canceling?
faqs.a: Yes. Calm's free tier includes limited meditation content, some sleep stories, and the Daily Calm (new daily meditation). Most of the library requires Premium.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Calm?
faqs.a: Annual subscriptions may be refundable within 30 days. For Apple/Google, use their refund processes. For direct subscriptions, contact Calm support.
Calm offers a lifetime subscription (one-time payment of ~$400) that never expires. If you purchased this, you don't need to cancel anything.

faqs.q: What's a free alternative to Calm?
faqs.a: Insight Timer (100k+ free meditations), Smiling Mind (completely free), UCLA Mindful (research-backed, free), and YouTube meditation channels.

refund.details: Calm offers refunds within 30 days of annual purchase through their support. Apple/Google subscriptions must be refunded through their respective platforms.

retentionTactics: Calm may offer a discounted rate or free month extension.
They show your meditation streak and total sessions completed.
